name: @tmi/api
description: Cloudflare Worker API + static host for the TMI tutor management portal

scripts.deploy:test: wrangler deploy --env test && wrangler deploy --env tutoring-test
scripts.db:reset: npm run db:rebuild && npm run db:seed && npm run db:platform-admin
scripts.db:studio: wrangler d1 execute tutoring-db --local --command="SELECT u.id, u.email, u.full_name, o.slug, m.status, u.last_login_at FROM users u LEFT JOIN org_members m ON m.user_id = u.id LEFT JOIN organizations o ON o.id = m.organization_id ORDER BY u.full_name"
scripts.db:rebuild:remote: node -e "console.error('Refusing: tutoring-db holds every organization\'s real records. Change it by hand, backed up and additively -- docs/database.md.'); process.exit(1)"
